environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster with the Pod Security admission controller configured at namespace level with label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline' (not restricted). The baseline profile permits non-root containers but does NOT block hostPath volumes or privileged escalation by itself — however, a custom ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL-based, v1beta1) is additionally deployed that evaluates spec.containers[*].securityContext.privileged == false AND spec.volumes[*].hostPath == null. The GraphQL backend runs behind an Istio AuthorizationPolicy that restricts the order-consumer's ServiceAccount to only invoke the 'customer' query field with a maximum selection depth of 2 via a custom EnvoyFilter applying ext_authz with an OPA sidecar policy (rego: `allow { input.parsed_body.query; not contains(input.parsed_body.query, "}") after position 80 }`). Network policy restricts egress from the consumer pod to only the GraphQL service ClusterIP on port 8080.
